title: Merge Two Congruence Equations
problemStatement: Given two congruence equations: X ≡ A (mod M) X ≡ B (mod N) Determine whether they can be merged into a single congruence. If possible, output the merged congruence with the smallest non-negative solution.
input: Integers A, M Integers B, N
output: The merged congruence or -1 if no solution exists.
